name: Singularity-RepoQL
description: Self-hosted, self-learning memory for coding agents with RepoQL code intelligence wired in: the memory stack quickstart, OpenChamber integration (agents + memory plugin + RepoQL MCP), optional Claude Office visualizer, and harness adapters.
license: MIT (see LICENSE); third-party components and licenses in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

openchamber_integration.note: config bundle (agents, rules, plugin, RepoQL MCP entry) for the upstream OpenChamber application; the application itself is installed separately

claude_office.note: compose + docs for the optional activity visualizer; the fork carries the validated Focus/seating updates

opencode_runtime.note: agent runtime embedded by the OpenChamber image

opencode_dcp.note: installed separately at runtime by OpenCode

self_learning.note: bounded agent-run self-learning loop: scripts/memory_turn_capture.py and scripts/memory_promote.py; caps and contract in docs/memory-capture-promotion.md; no new hook framework, store or service

repoql_integration.note: connects the OpenChamber bundle to the user's existing rql installation over MCP; RepoQL is installed and licensed separately (repoql.com)
